County/state is the available location precision. No coordinates or street addresses are inferred.

coverage: 97 visible archive entries: 47 in 2022 and 50 in 2025. Literal dates cover 39/52 and 47/52 calendar Sundays; eight earlier October observations are included within these totals.
limits: Archive dates and filename dates are separate evidence; neither independently verifies delivery. Audio links were observed, not played or downloaded. No transcripts were acquired.
Named-speaker groups mix months and item types. Current directory name matches do not establish a historical role or a comparable same-speaker panel.
screen_update.speaker_evidence: Item-level names are preserved. Aris and Nicholas Metrakos are linked through a current official directory; unknown names and the role-only “His Eminence” attribution remain distinct.

orthodox.access: Audio link destinations were observed on the archive page. No recordings were requested, played or downloaded; no transcripts were acquired.
orthodox.date_basis: Dates are literal archive labels, not verified delivery or upload dates. Filename dates remain separate and do not correct displayed dates.
orthodox.directory_caveat: The current official directory supports Aris and Nicholas Metrakos name/parish associations, not their identity or role on every historical date. Role-only labels remain unresolved.
limits: Page heading is not a speaker attribution.
Unknown and role-only speaker identities are not filled from the page title or filenames.
No absence-of-sermon inference from unobserved dates.
Youth/adult entries on the same date remain separate items but count as one observed Sunday.
Different URLs and titles cannot establish distinct recordings or content without audio access.
Download links do not establish permission to transcribe, redistribute or build a corpus.
The eight earlier October observations are included in these 97 archive entries; do not add them.
The November 30, 2022 cutoff is descriptive. It establishes neither AI use nor non-use.

studies.name: Boussalis, Coan & Holman
studies.citation: Boussalis, Coan and Holman (online 2020; journal 2021), Political Speech in Religious Sermons
studies.status: Public source code and documented token sample
studies.reported_scale: The paper reports over 110,000 sermons. Its repository describes a separate 10,000-sermon token sample whose binary contents were not independently checked here.
studies.available: README, package DESCRIPTION and file listings inspected. README describes a 10,000-sermon SermonCentral sample with sermon ID, labels and tokens. A sermons.Rdata file is present (11,041,122 bytes); its binary contents were not downloaded or independently row-checked.
studies.holdings: Citation and source notes only; no underlying corpus acquired.
studies.rights: DESCRIPTION declares MIT + file LICENSE. No LICENSE file appears in the inspected repository root or package-root listings. This does not establish permission to republish underlying third-party sermon material.
studies.linkage: The documented sample schema does not supply church, event date or speaker fields. Paper describes geographic linkage, but those fields were not demonstrated in the inspected sample artifact.
studies.next_action: Use the published labeling and validation design as a method reference. Do not equate a public token sample with a continuous same-church, same-speaker corpus. No source code was executed.

overlap.method: Compare normalized church names within the same state. Case, punctuation, whitespace and St/Saint variations normalized. Exact name-state equality is candidate generation only; location and independent source identity are required to accept a match. Broad fuzzy-name similarities were not accepted.
overlap.conclusion: No overlap has been established. This does not prove zero actual overlap under all aliases or historic identities. Do not add 150 to 86 as a deduplicated total.
